items.title: Roland Hanna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: Perugia is a place almost in the center of Italy... Perugia was just so beautiful to me.

ctx.x: Nice chords. What was the inspiration for this particular song. Was there one?

Perugia is a place almost in the center of Italy, and it’s a city on the top of a hill, high on the top of a hill, where the Etruscans, a group of people who escaped from slavery or enslavement in Africa and ran to this area, and stayed there and fought back the Romans and other people by throwing hot oil and rocks and everything else down. Finally the Romans said let them go. Forget them. And they won out. If you read that history, it’s really interesting. And when I got there, knowing nothing about that, I…
Thad Jones-Mel Lewis band was a nice career thing for you to do it seems like, and you had some great moments on that record too.
